README – Kampala Flood Accessibility Dataset Overview This dataset contains model outputs and derived data supporting the analysis of flood-induced changes in physical accessibility to healthcare facilities in Kampala, Uganda. Coverage: Uganda. The portal files it under the publisher Zenodo. Its tags are Kampala, pluvial floods, Travel time, Healthcare Access, Accessmod. The repository dates the deposit 2025; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
